section4_relabeling_hypothesis.note: Z is derived (Z=(XY)^-1), not an independent generator; the naive 3-tuple Y<->Z swap test is structurally invalid (see naive_swap_test below). The correct test is 2-generator simultaneous conjugacy of independent pairs (X,Y) and (X,Z).

naive_swap_test.invalid_because: swapping Y2,Z2 in the raw 3-tuple does not preserve the group relation X*Y*Z=1 in general, so the swapped target is not a valid dessin triple; a false/true result here is not by itself informative
